title: chore(deps): update vulnerable dependencies
author: Kielek
body:
# Changes

## Summary

This PR mitigates the reported dependency vulnerabilities across npm, Hex, and Go.

## Changes By Project / Technology

### Root npm

- Updated root npm lockfile so `brace-expansion` resolves to a patched version.
- Covers `GHSA-jxxr-4gwj-5jf2`.

### Frontend npm (`src/frontend`)

- Refreshed the frontend npm lockfile to patched dependency versions.
- Covers `brace-expansion`: `GHSA-jxxr-4gwj-5jf2`.
- Covers `systeminformation`: `GHSA-hvx9-hwr7-wjj9`.
- Covers `protobufjs` advisories: `GHSA-jggg-4jg4-v7c6`, `GHSA-2pr8-phx7-x9h3`, `GHSA-66ff-xgx4-vchm`, `GHSA-685m-2w69-288q`, `GHSA-75px-5xx7-5xc7`, `GHSA-fx83-v9x8-x52w`, `GHSA-jvwf-75h9-cwgg`.
- Covers `@protobufjs/utf8`: `GHSA-q6x5-8v7m-xcrf`.

### Payment npm (`src/payment`)

- Updated `protobufjs` resolution, including the OpenTelemetry override, to patched versions.
- The removal of several `@protobufjs/*` lockfile entries is expected because newer `protobufjs` versions no longer resolve the same helper package tree.
- Covers `GHSA-jggg-4jg4-v7c6`, `GHSA-2pr8-phx7-x9h3`, `GHSA-66ff-xgx4-vchm`, `GHSA-685m-2w69-288q`, `GHSA-75px-5xx7-5xc7`, `GHSA-fx83-v9x8-x52w`, `GHSA-jvwf-75h9-cwgg`, `GHSA-q6x5-8v7m-xcrf`.

### React Native npm (`src/react-native-app`)

- Refreshed the React Native lockfile to patched versions of `protobufjs`, `brace-expansion`, and `ws`.
- As with payment, removed `@protobufjs/*` lockfile entries are a result of the newer `protobufjs` dependency graph.
- Covers `GHSA-jxxr-4gwj-5jf2`, `GHSA-58qx-3vcg-4xpx`, `GHSA-jggg-4jg4-v7c6`, `GHSA-2pr8-phx7-x9h3`, `GHSA-66ff-xgx4-vchm`, `GHSA-685m-2w69-288q`, `GHSA-75px-5xx7-5xc7`, `GHSA-fx83-v9x8-x52w`, `GHSA-jvwf-75h9-cwgg`, `GHSA-q6x5-8v7m-xcrf`.

### flagd-ui / Hex (`src/flagd-ui`)

- Regenerated `mix.lock` from scratch.
- Removed stale Cowboy/Cowlib-related packages that are no longer part of the current resolved Bandit-based dependency graph.
- No Cowlib Git pin is used; the affected Cowboy/Cowlib graph is no longer resolved by this subproject.
- Covers `EEF-CVE-2026-8466 / GHSA-jfc2-q6qh-g5x8`, `EEF-CVE-2026-43968 / GHSA-hv23-4qp7-8c8r`, `EEF-CVE-2026-43969 / GHSA-g2wm-735q-3f56`, `EEF-CVE-2026-43970 / GHSA-84f2-rp86-235p`, `EEF-CVE-2026-7790 / GHSA-32p9-57cr-4x65`.

### Product Catalog Go (`src/product-catalog`)

- Updated Go module dependencies, including `golang.org/x/net`, to a patched version.
- Covers the dependency-module part of `GO-2026-4918`.
